title: Counit identification of a scalar support-triangle comparison
statement:
Let $i:Z\hookrightarrow P$ be a closed immersion with complementary open $j:U\hookrightarrow P$, and let $A\to B$ be a unital map of finite commutative rings [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Use ordinary etale module derived categories, the support triangles $i_*Ri_R^!L\to L\to Rj_{*,R}j^*L$ for $R=A,B$, and their counit/unit maps [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, lem-exc-closed-support-triangle]. Write $T_W=-\otimes_A^LB_W$ and $\operatorname{Res}$ for exact restriction of scalars [lem-pur-sheaf-ring-derived-coefficient-adjunction]. Let $L$ and $TL$, their closed exceptional images and the open terms in these triangles all be bounded below. Suppose the canonical projection $q_{i,Ri_A^!L}:T_Pi_{*,A}Ri_A^!L\to i_{*,B}T_ZRi_A^!L$ is an isomorphism. Suppose a morphism from the $T$-image of the $A$-support triangle to the restriction of the $B$-support triangle has middle map the identity of $\operatorname{Res}(TL)$ and right map the canonical open coefficient projection. Identify its first source term using $\operatorname{Res}(q_i)$ and the canonical restriction/direct-image isomorphisms [lem-sbc-canonical-restrict-scalars-functor-comparisons]. Then its first map is $i_*\operatorname{Res}(b_i)$, where
$$b_i:T_ZRi_A^!L\to Ri_B^!T_PL$$
is the $i_{*,B}\dashv Ri_B^!$ transpose of $T_P\epsilon_{i,A}\circ q_i^{-1}$. If the open coefficient projection is an isomorphism, then $b_i$ is an isomorphism. No injectivity after restriction of scalars and no flatness of $B/A$ is assumed.
